title: 第149章 抢粮食
slug: 穿越民国获得每日签到系统
content_zh:
第(1/3)页

杨树浦码头，凌晨四点，江面开始起雾，浓得化不开。

富士丸泊在三号位，黑影幢幢，像一头蹲在水里的巨兽。

码头四周加了双岗，探照灯每隔三十秒扫一圈，光柱在雾里劈开又合拢。

两个宪兵牵着狼狗，在泊位来回走。

狗舌头拖在外面，哈着白气，爪子踩在霜上，咔咔响。

苦力们扛着麻袋往舱里跑，脚步踉跄。

就在这时，一个老头脚下一滑，麻袋摔在地上，米撒了一地。

“八嘎！”押运官松本一脚踹过去，老头滚了两圈，趴在地上不敢动。

“太君太君，对不起……对不起……路太滑……”

松本拔出手枪，顶在老头后脑勺，“我不想听你滴借口，给我舔干净！一粒米都不准剩！”

“是……是……”

老头趴在地上，手指冻得发僵。

米粒嵌在砖缝里，他抠得指甲翻裂，血渗出来，混着米，一把一把往嘴里塞。

春日丸泊在隔壁，马达已经轰鸣，第七中队的士兵列队上船，皮靴踩得甲板咚咚响。

两挺机枪架在船头，迫击炮用帆布盖着。

炮管露出半截，黑漆漆的，像根等着睁眼的铁管子。

“这鬼天气，能见度不到三十米。”

春日丸的船长站在驾驶室，端着酒杯，“松本君，迫击炮都搬上来了，是不是太紧张了？”

“闭嘴！”

松本从富士丸跳过来，军刀在腰侧晃荡，“前后甲板加双岗，狼狗放船头。

发现可疑船只，直接射击，不用请示！”

“嗨！”

探照灯扫过江面，光柱在雾里劈开又合拢。

四点整，富士丸驶入弯道，船速放慢，马达声低了，船头像在浓雾里摸索。

松本站在前甲板，军刀拄地，手按着刀柄。

雾太大，他看不清江面，只能听见水流声，哗啦，哗啦。

“探照灯！”

一束光柱扫出去，在雾里散开，能见度不高，照不远。

content_en:
Page (1/3)

At Yangshupu Pier, at four o'clock in the morning, fog began to form on the river, and it was so thick that it could not be dissolved.

Fujimaru was parked in position three, with dark shadows like a giant beast squatting in the water.

Double posts were added around the pier, and searchlights scanned once every thirty seconds, beams of light splitting and closing in the fog.

Two gendarmes led the wolfdog back and forth in the berth.

The dog's tongue was hanging out, breathing white air, and its paws clicked on the frost.

The coolies ran toward the cabin carrying sacks, stumbling.

At this moment, an old man slipped, the sack fell to the ground, and the rice was scattered all over the floor.

"Baga!" Escort officer Matsumoto kicked him. The old man rolled twice and lay on the ground without daring to move.

"Taijun, Taijun, I'm sorry...I'm sorry...the road is too slippery..."

Matsumoto pulled out his pistol and put it on the back of the old man's head, "I don't want to hear your excuses, lick it clean for me! Not even a grain of rice is left!"

"Yes...yes..."

The old man lay on the ground, his fingers stiff with cold.

The grains of rice were embedded in the cracks of the bricks. He dug his nails until his nails cracked, blood seeped out, and mixed with the rice, he stuffed handfuls into his mouth.

Kasuga Maru was moored next door, its motor was already roaring, and the soldiers of the 7th Squadron lined up to board the ship, their leather boots making a thumping sound on the deck.

Two machine guns were mounted on the bow, and the mortars were covered with canvas.

Half of the barrel was exposed, pitch black, like an iron pipe waiting to open its eyes.

"In this damn weather, visibility is less than thirty meters."

The captain of Kasugamaru stood in the cab, holding a wine glass, "Matsumoto-kun, the mortars have been brought up, are you too nervous?"

"Shut up!"

Matsumoto jumped over from Fujimaru, his saber dangling at his side, "Add double posts on the front and rear decks, and put the wolfdog on the bow.

If you find a suspicious ship, shoot directly without asking for instructions!"

"Hi!"

The searchlight swept across the river, and the beam of light split and closed in the fog.

At four o'clock sharp, Fujimaru entered a curve. The boat slowed down, the motor sound became low, and the bow seemed to be groping in thick fog.

Matsumoto stood on the front deck with his saber on the ground and his hand on the handle.

The fog was so thick that he couldn't see the surface of the river clearly. He could only hear the sound of water flowing, rushing, rushing.

"Searchlight!"

A beam of light swept out and spread out in the fog. The visibility was not high and the light could not reach far.
